name: com.neshgames.unity-performance-analyzers
description: Roslyn analyzers that enforce Unity performance and correctness conventions at compile time. Rules adapt automatically to the packages your assembly references (UniTask, ZString, R3) and to whether your project targets WebGL.

samples.description: unity / ci / webgl agent-oriented severity profiles. Use unity.ruleset in the Editor and ci.ruleset with upa-cli.
A script that intentionally violates several rules, to verify the analyzers are loaded and configured. Delete after verifying.
